3.name: Episode 1
3.overview: A father-son work trip to Spain turns into a nightmare after devastating news reaches Charly and Erick. Yeimy's work for Soul and Bass continues.

3.name: Episode 2
3.overview: Yeimy's notebook falls into enemy hands, as an unidentified body ignites chaos. Yara sings for Patrono while Soraya schemes behind her back.

3.name: Episode 3
3.overview: As gossip and accusations mount online, Charly sinks into despair. Yara fights for her place in the industry, and an accident triggers old demons.

3.name: Episode 4
3.overview: In the aftermath of Yeimy's disappearance, her family starts to fall apart, and enemies begin to close in. Deep in the jungle, a figure emerges.

3.name: Episode 5
3.overview: As Yeimy struggles to survive without an identity, Charly falls into a dangerous scheme that pits him against everyone. Prison becomes a battleground.

3.name: Episode 6
3.overview: While Yeimy fights to reclaim her identity, a sinister video game turns Charly's tragedy into a spectacle. Yara shines during an important audition.

3.name: Episode 7
3.overview: Yeimy's voice echoes around her home, driving Charly crazy. Severo hides Yeimy's identity. Yara's talent reignites Soul and Bass, sparking Irma's envy.

3.name: Episode 8
3.overview: Severo's boat is intercepted, while Rusvel plots to recover Yara. Charly and Alma face their grief, and Mike continues to pull strings.

3.name: Episode 9
3.overview: As the truth begins to emerge, Charly tries to heal from the shadows that haunted him. Yeimy is startled into action, and Yara defies Marinilla's power.

3.name: Episode 10
3.overview: Yeimy pieces together her memory. Irma fights for the musical throne as Yara debuts her first song. A lost camera triggers a manhunt.

3.name: Episode 11
3.overview: Yara establishes herself as the new voice of Soul and Bass, and Irma seeks the source of the messages. The Kraken returns to the jungle.

3.name: Episode 12
3.overview: Charly demands focus and discipline, as Yara conquers those at Soul and Bass. As she nears her goal, Genoveva prepares for an irreversible shakeup.

3.name: Episode 13
3.overview: A new reward shakes things up for Mike. As Yara deals with the burden of success, she's forced to confront her secret feelings for Charly.

3.name: Episode 14
3.overview: A brutal attack shakes Soul and Bass and unleashes a wave of suspicions and revelations. In the jungle, Yeimy's safety hangs in the balance.

3.name: Episode 15
3.overview: As Charly recovers, Yara's guilt forces her to make a drastic change. Mike's plan moves forward, and Severo's pathway is clear to be a millionaire.

3.name: Episode 16
3.overview: Irma's new song climbs the charts, and Yara makes her return. As Charly regains creative control, tensions with Erick mount and disrupt Soul and Bass.

3.name: Episode 17
3.overview: A cruel twist forces Irma to face online hate. Yara must choose between the garage and music, while Soraya intensifies her fight for Charly.

3.name: Episode 18
3.overview: A song revives what was lost. A video kicks off a web of deception that sparks Charly's suspicions about Yara. Irma tries to recover from betrayal.

3.name: Episode 19
3.overview: Charly confronts Fredy in prison, and they strike a deal. Yara is resolved to set boundaries, while a new Soul and Bass alliance threatens Mike's plans.

3.name: Episode 20
3.overview: Charly is entangled in a web of suspicion as Alma disappears. Irma reinvents herself and Mike accelerates his plans before everything is lost.

3.name: Episode 21
3.overview: While Chacón falls into the Vallejo's trap, Yara says goodbye to Charly, throwing him off balance. Irma and Trejos' success irks Erick.

3.name: Episode 22
3.overview: Irma and Trejos celebrate their success and Erick records with his crew. In prison, Mike suffers from a betrayal, and a dark plot shakes Soul and Bass.

3.name: Episode 23
3.overview: Erick finds inspiration in Leo Fire as Yara shines in the studio. Fredy's betrayal ignites a plot of revenge that could change everything.

3.name: Episode 24
3.overview: Mike celebrates his freedom by launching Parce Music. Irma and Trejos closeness stirs up social media. Yeimy tries to get back home.

3.name: Episode 25
3.overview: Yara and Charly grow closer in Guatapé, while Yeimy tries to flee from her closely guarded confinement. Mike maneuvers to seize control in the industry.

3.name: Episode 26
3.overview: Mike steps up his verbal attacks on Yeimy, while a message shakes Yara's trust in Charly. Irma is kidnapped, and a spot in Paris ignites tensions.

3.name: Episode 27
3.overview: Axl enters prison as Mike continues his plans to destroy Soul and Bass. Charly searches for Irma amid threats that shake him and others.

3.name: Episode 28
3.overview: Mike intensifies his campaign against Charly with lawsuits and scandals, as the fight for Paris heats up. Yeimy and Irma bond in their cell.

3.name: Episode 29
3.overview: While Yeimy and Irma advance their escape plan, Mike unleashes his fury. Soraya betrays Yara, and Erick relies on music to keep Irma's fans full of hope.

3.name: Episode 30
3.overview: Yeimy and Irma seek refuge in the woods while Mike loses control. At the ranch, Genoveva and Jerónimo intercept the police but are unprepared.

3.name: Episode 31
3.overview: Yeimy's return shakes everything up. As Irma reexamines her life, Erick struggles with the distance. Charly makes a vow to reclaim what's been lost.

3.name: Episode 32
3.overview: Genoveva is shaken from her confrontation with Irma. Yara struggles with massive changes. Yeimy returns to Soul and Bass and puts Yara on the spot.

3.name: Episode 33
3.overview: Charly's obsession with winning Yeimy back resurfaces old wounds. As Genoveva plots her revenge, Yeimy struggles to conceal her fragile health.

3.name: Episode 34
3.overview: Yeimy's peace in Guatapé is broken by Charly and Yara. Mike unleashes a legal battle on Ángel, and Yeimy does everything to keep her secret under wraps.

3.name: Episode 35
3.overview: An anticipated concert turns into a battleground as Yeimy faces a challenging night, Yara strives to shine and Mike pulls strings to let chaos reign.

3.name: Episode 36
3.overview: Following the blackout, Charly makes a moving message, reigniting the audience's energy. As Yeimy gathers her strength, an enemy is watching closely.

3.name: Episode 37
3.overview: Yeimy and Charly are a triumph at the concert. Yara wavers between her feeling for Charly and a proposal from Meteoro. Yeimy keeps her health a secret.

3.name: Episode 38
3.overview: Yeimy and Charly confront Genoveva over a longstanding grudge. Yara makes a decision that could change her career. Mike conspires to ruin Soul and Bass.

3.name: Episode 39
3.overview: Soraya confesses a secret to Yara and fears being fired. Mike plots to sabotage an upcoming performance, and Yeimy suffers from a health scare.

3.name: Episode 40
3.overview: A painful revelation shakes Charly and Yeimy. With time of the essence, Mike changes course and targets the most vulnerable of the Soul and Bass family.

3.name: Episode 41
3.overview: As Yeimy's health deteriorates, she prepares herself and her family for a painful goodbye. Genoveva's desperate search for Jerónimo yields no results.

3.name: Episode 42
3.overview: Charly's grief turns into revenge as he makes a terrible vow. Mike tries to rehabilitate his image, unaware that enemies loom in the background.

3.name: Episode 43
3.overview: Mike points the finger at Charly for his attack. As tensions rise between Irma and Yara, everyone wonders: Who will be the new Queen of Flow?

3.name: Episode 44
3.overview: Genoveva's rage drives her to the edge as she goes after Mike. Yara's music career hangs in the balance as a media war with Irma unleashes chaos.

3.name: Episode 45
3.overview: Yara makes a decision that leaves Charly devastated. Mike is terrorized as Genoveva plots her revenge. The rivalry between Yara and Irma intensifies.

3.name: Episode 46
3.overview: Yara shines at an event, while Charly is accused of being Yeimy's executioner. Soraya spreads new gossip, and Genoveva prepares a drone for Botero.

3.name: Episode 47
3.overview: Yara celebrates Alma's birthday but struggles seeing Charly. Botero is the victim of an attack. Mike confronts Charly with an old memory of Yeimy.

3.name: Episode 48
3.overview: A fashion show performance destroys Irma's confidence but leads to a truce. Mike's setup puts Charly and Alma at risk.

overview: Seventeen years after being wrongly imprisoned, a talented songwriter seeks justice against the men who caused her downfall and killed her family.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Yeimy Montoya, a talented young woman, serves a wrongful sentence in a New York prison. Her only desire is to get out to take revenge against all those who destroyed her life. In the top of the list is Charly Flow, an acclaimed and famous singer of reggaeton who plagiarized the lyrics of her songs, played with her and sent her to jail. Yeimy must fake her death and change her identity. She will return as Tamy Andrade, a wealthy reggaeton producer, who puts an end to Charly Flow’s career.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Yeimy faces new dangers that threaten her life and that of her family. The arrival of an enemy who knows her well and is after her, while Juancho, her partner, sees her producer lose ground to a mighty competitor who comes into the scene. Her world, and that of all the people she loves, is on shaky ground, while Charly Flow, from the shadows, does everything he can to recover his freedom. Yeimy's whole universe will be at stake when Charly reappears and gets together with his new allies to destroy her.
